fact: In the IMPULSE assessment, with data collected between November 2022 and July 2024 in Bangui and health regions 1, 2 and 7, 21.4% of the 14 Central African Republic facilities assessed (hospitals and health centres) used a functional electronic system for data entry and analysis, against 83.3% of the 6 district health offices, all data offices using DHIS2; the sample is not national and is not split by tier.
title: Facility newborn and stillbirth data use and enabling factors at different levels of the health system: findings of the IMPULSE study across 142 sites in the Central African Republic, Ethiopia, Tanzania, and Uganda
